items.title: Hong Kong Connection: CX841 Arrival → CX472 Boarding (~1h40 Transit)
items.getThere: HKIA transfer with onward boarding pass: follow the directional signs to the Departures level for boarding gates; transfer security screening is mandatory before reaching the gate.
highlights: Have boarding pass and passport ready before the screening point.
Electronic and metal items in hand baggage go in a separate tray; walk-through metal detector, possible hand search.
tips: Liquids sealed in tamper-evident duty-free bags get extra LAGs screening at transfer security and may be unbagged; HKIA advises allowing extra time.
Power banks departing HKG: max two per passenger, carry-on only, and recharging them in flight is prohibited (HKIA notice, 30 Mar 2026).
items.watch: Do not exit through Arrivals/immigration — that is for entering Hong Kong, not for a same-day connection.

items.title: Cathay Pacific CX472: Hong Kong → Taipei
items.hours: Scheduled 15:45 HKT → 17:35 Taipei; 1h50 block (late-Oct timetable showed 17:40 arrival).
highlights: Usually an Airbus A330-300 on this rotation.
Recent actual departures mostly 16:00–16:50 but arrivals 17:17–18:31 thanks to padding.
items.watch: PlaneMapper logged 8 late departures in the prior month (average 32 min). Third-party data; the Cathay app and boarding pass are final.

items.title: Touchdown TPE T1: Immigration → Bags → EasyCard → Airport MRT
items.cost: Airport MRT A12 Terminal 1 ↔ A1 Taipei Main Station NT$160. Empty EasyCard NT$100 (top-ups NT$100 multiples at machines; any amount at the station information counter).
items.getThere: Express train A12 → A1 Taipei Main: 39 min (commuter 53 min). Express and commuter trains alternate about every 7.5 min. Last express to Taipei from A12 departs 22:58.
highlights: Airport MRT gates also take contactless Visa/Mastercard/JCB/UnionPay and phone wallets at the full single-journey fare.
Taipei Main (A1) connects to the Red (Tamsui-Xinyi), Blue (Bannan) and Green (Songshan-Xindian) lines, TRA and THSR.
tips: TWAC must be submitted online within 7 days before arrival; submission is free.
Board the express, not the commuter: 39 vs 53 min to Taipei Main.

items.title: Check In: Via Hotel Taipei Station — Bags Down
items.getThere: From Taipei Main Station take Exit Z10, then walk about 8 min along Chongqing S. Rd. Sec. 1 to No. 60.
highlights: Official name: 丰居旅店 北車館 (VIA Hotel Taipei Station), 台北市中正區重慶南路一段60號. Tel +886-2-2314-2121.
tips: If you arrive before your room is ready, the hotel will hold luggage so you can head out.

items.title: Fuhong Beef Noodles (backup: Xiao Wu) — Arrival Dinner
items.hours: Fuhong: 24 hours, year-round. Xiao Wu: also open 24 hours.
highlights: Fuhong (Luoyang St., Ximending edge): rich beef-tallow broth with springy noodles; a late-night canteen for night owls and taxi drivers.
Xiao Wu (same Luoyang St. 'beef noodle war zone'): signature red-braised broth with a distinctive savory edge and soft-stewed beef.
tips: Both being 24h means no closing-time pressure tonight — if Fuhong's line is long, walk to Xiao Wu.
items.watch: Prices and payment methods were not found on an authoritative page; bring cash as a fallback.

items.title: Ximending at Night
items.hours: Red House: Sun 11:00–21:00 (free; closed Mondays). Red House creative market (North Plaza): Sun 14:30–21:30, vendors pack up 21:00–21:30.
items.getThere: MRT Ximen on the Blue (Bannan) Line; the Red House is about 1 min on foot from Exit 1.
highlights: Youth-culture hub: street dancing, cosplay, Wannian Plaza accessory shops and the tattoo street.
Red House (1908): one of Taiwan's earliest government-built public markets and the oldest intact Grade-3 heritage market building, at 成都路10號.
tips: Arriving 9:30 PM you will see the Red House exterior only; the creative market will be packing up.
items.watch: Red House interior closes 21:00 on Sundays, before this stop starts.

items.title: Back to Via Hotel
items.getThere: MRT Blue (Bannan) Line from Ximen to Taipei Main Station, exit Z10, then ~8 min walk along Chongqing S. Rd. Sec. 1 to No. 60.
